steps.en: Each company is counted once, using its most recent email address
steps.id: Tiap company dihitung sekali, memakai alamat email terbarunya
steps.why_en: The email refresh is switched off in production settings, so the old stored email is used.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan email dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, jadi email lama yang dipakai.

steps.en: The email lists the unpaid notices and mentions the 3rd reminder letter
steps.id: Email memuat daftar notice belum dibayar dan menyebut surat reminder ke-3
steps.why_en: The notice list is filled in, but the wording of the email is not in the project files.
steps.why_id: Daftar notice terisi, tetapi kalimat email tidak ada di file proyek.

steps.en: The email is sent to each company owner in the batch run
steps.id: Email dikirim ke tiap company owner dalam batch
steps.why_en: Email sending for this purpose and the sending job are both switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman email untuk keperluan ini dan job pengirimnya sama-sama dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.
